question: How do D180 prior-inflammation versus control relative TSS-proxy rank differences compare with the exact frozen S3 D30 description, with D6 as the acute reference?
decision: Describe every exact S3 window at D180 and compare finite signed and absolute rank displacements with frozen D30/D6, including both widths and all five paper anchors. Smaller, larger, opposite or mixed differences refine this fixed-universe durability description. Return verified outputs for coordinator review before final S6 progression assessment; no original retained-domain or maintenance-mechanism inference.
strongest_rival: Unknown track processing units and pooled-animal membership, mixture and D180 HiSeq2500 versus D6/D30 HiSeq4000 may affect cross-time relative ordering. Global rank constraints and zero-tie mass can create nonzero rank contrasts at locally zero windows. A source or dictionary mismatch could invalidate extraction. Shared-source and cross-time library comparisons do not establish matched animals or independent replication.
discriminator: Qualify all four acquired D180 identities, hashes, headers and required mm10 chromosome lengths before any research-window fetch. Reuse exactly the frozen S3 windows and gene map; stream complete finite base-array means. Compute within-library tied percentile ranks and PI minus Ctrl rank differences, all unpaired ranges, exact D180-versus-D30/D6 and width summaries, and all five anchors. Separate stdlib verification plus independently interval-weighted rereads checks arithmetic and coverage, not biological mechanism.
exposure_record: Published D180 figures, frozen S3 D6/D30 values, all fixed anchors and the earlier Naik analyses are exposed. Coordinator approved the exact method on 19 November and subsequently closed S6B without revision. Acquisition read bytes/hashes only. Seven constructed-source tests and artificial layouts used no actual D180 research-window values. Exact code/input freeze precedes header qualification and dependent signal extraction; this is exposed description, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Deposited ATAC library from published pooled biological-replicate preparations; exact pool/animal identities, overlap and cross-time matching unresolved. The computational endpoint is a fixed annotation-boundary window rank within each library, not a peak, original memory domain or animal-level longitudinal effect.
nesting_and_overlap: Four original GSE92967 D180 libraries are the same study as the frozen eight D6/D30 ATAC libraries. Genes sharing an anchor remain multiple mappings to one computational window. Overlapping windows and four unpaired contrasts are dependent; they are not independent replicates. Source suffixes do not establish matching. No D180 RNA or RNA-to-function pairing.
population_and_selection: All 21760 exact S3 windows and 21775 M9 protein-coding gene mappings per flank, chr1-19/X, primary +/-1000 and sensitivity +/-2000 bp. No regeneration, clipping change, outcome selection or excluded window. D180 GSM2652413/14 PI and GSM2652415/16 control. Preserve Aim2, Casp1, Il1b, Il1r1 and Il18 at their exact five fixed versioned IDs and anchor keys.
contrast: D180 mean PI minus mean control within-library rank in percentile points; all four unpaired PI_i minus Ctrl_j contrasts and their range. Primary D180 versus frozen D30, acute reference D6: signed shift and absolute-magnitude difference quantiles, smaller/larger/computationally equal fractions, opposite-sign and zero-status-change fractions. Same-anchor width sensitivity uses signed and absolute 2kb-minus-1kb contrast shifts. All-window denominators, no matched-animal effects.
endpoint: Exact base-array window mean and encoded-zero count support within-library average-tie percentile P=100*(average_rank-1)/(N-1). Relative ranks, group rank differences and their finite spread are measured endpoints. Raw signal magnitudes are not compared as normalized absolute accessibility; no original retained-domain, global opening, RNA, repair or maintenance-mechanism endpoint is supplied.
methods: S6C_D180_METHOD_V1 fixes all inputs, joins, comparison rules and outputs. One contract first verifies S3 receipt-bound universe and original D180 source metadata, then pinned Python3.13.18/pybbi0.4.2/NumPy2.5.5 saves all headers/dictionaries and rejects any required chromosome mismatch before research-window fetch. Exact nonzoomed base-array means require complete finite coverage. Reuse S3 tie ranks and 1e-10 pp computational zero/range rules. Preserve all old values, D180 means/zeros/ranks/contrasts, seven prespecified quantiles and complete comparisons/anchors. Separate stdlib sorting/grouping/math.fsum/linear quantiles verifies every output; up to 296 interval-iterator readbacks verify local means and zeros within scaled1e-10. Two complete-data PNG/PDF figures, no pairing lines or selected persistent subset.
missingness_and_exclusions: No missing-window imputation, zero substitution, excluded source, label repair, new interval, new marker or outcome-selected subset. Absent/duplicate/changed source or window/mapping, required chromosome mismatch, nonfinite/missing base, source identity/hash mismatch or verification failure stops dependent work and preserves partial evidence. Exact zero means, all-encoded-zero windows, computational contrast zero and range-includes-zero remain separate.
multiplicity: Finite descriptive comparisons across both entire universes and all five exposed anchors, with every prespecified result retained. No p-values, population confidence intervals, equivalence claims, classifier, new correlation model or independent evidence counts from genes/windows/unpaired differences.
precision_basis: No population precision estimate with unresolved pool identities. Complete source descriptions and independent arithmetic/readback tolerance1e-10 are computational safeguards, not biological effect margins. Four unpaired contrasts describe finite spread, not confidence limits or four independent replicates.
interpretation_limit: Relative-order durability in fixed TSS-proxy windows does not reproduce original retained domains, establish absolute accessibility decay/global opening, or identify chromatin-memory maintenance, individual-cell persistence or repair. Mean rank50 and mean full-universe contrast0 are structural. Locally constant-zero windows may have nonzero rank contrasts. D180 platform and unresolved processing/pooling restrict cross-time interpretation; shared data are not independent replication.
stop_rule: Commit the exposed exact contract/method/code before any actual D180 research-window values. All four hashes/identities and required dictionaries must qualify before dependent extraction. Stop on any missing/nonfinite base, changed universe, source/join/rank/summary/readback disagreement, extraction/readback peak RSS over2GiB, provisional entrypoint over2hours or derived artifacts over50MiB; preserve partial outputs and failures. Do not re-extract D6/D30, run raw reads, install software, repair labels, infer matched animals or promote claims. Return actual complete results/figures for coordinator review, then assess justified progression beyond reproduction; no external action.
